## PDF page 69

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=69)

```text
                             PREFLOP


Now you will start putting together everything that you have learned so far.
Each page gives you a preflop spot and first asks you to fill in the %-form and
combo form for two possible ranges. Copy/paste the included range strands
into your software to quickly find these numbers.




Then, choose which range you would prefer to use in this situation and write
one or two sentences explaining why.

This exercise gives you extra reps tying together the technical elements of
ranges, and you should be seeing how %-form and combos relate. If nothing
else, remember that 0%=0 combos, and 100%=1,326 combos. So you should
be able to eyeball how many combos are included at 10%, 25%, and 50%.




                                   PA G E 6 9
```
